changelog: Major version bump to `6.0.0` per user directive. No breaking API changes in scripts or CI contracts; the bump marks the completion of the v5.13x hardening cycle (Hard Rule #6 enforcement, guideline mirror drift detection, branch-protection nightly drift, sync auto-fix workflow, drift report artifacts).

`scripts/sync-check.mjs` refactored from 416 lines to 202 lines by extracting `scripts/lib/sync-check-normalisers.mjs` and `scripts/lib/sync-check-report.mjs`. Restores compliance with Hard Rule #6 (300-line file cap) without any behaviour change: same flags (`--verbose`, `--fix`, `--report <dir>`), same exit codes (0/1/2), same normaliser semantics.
